name: Ciragan Palace Hotel Kempinski
positioning: Ottoman palace hotel on the Bosphorus in Istanbul, run by Kempinski as Çırağan Palace Kempinski Istanbul
best_for: Travelers who want to stay in a former Ottoman palace
Guests interested in a palace hammam and Turkish fine dining

facts.text: Before becoming a hotel, the palace was a royal court, parliamentary meeting space and beauty pageant venue.
Rooms have four-poster beds, and many have tulip-patterned headboards.
Bathroom products are specially made by Atelier Rebul.
Le Fumoir is a cigar lounge at the hotel.
Breakfast is a Turkish buffet spread with eggs made to order.
The spa has indoor and outdoor pools.
Guests can arrive by private boat.
The hotel is a member of Leading Hotels of the World.

highlights.text: The original palace hammam can be seen on a private tour arranged through the front desk.
The original palace houses several suites furnished with antiques.
The spa has its own hammam of polished marble.
Akdeniz and Tuğra Restaurant both serve Turkish dishes in a fine dining setting.

considerations.text: Reaching attractions such as the Grand Bazaar or Hagia Sophia requires a taxi or public transport.
WhataHotel notes the historic building layout may mean varying room configurations.
